groups.description: Food made by cooking a dough of flour and liquid, usually by baking.
Bread made from dough fermented with a culture of wild yeast and bacteria.
A way of eating in which a person eats animal foods and avoids plant foods.
Domesticated canine animals commonly kept as pets or used for work.
An expression of welcome or goodwill addressed to someone during the morning.
A greeting that expresses a wish for someone to have a pleasant morning.
A drink prepared from roasted coffee beans, and establishments where that drink is prepared and served.
Sounds arranged through rhythm, melody or harmony for expression or enjoyment.
